result.reason: The added operative language reaches the preferred position: transition assistance is available for up to six months at then-current rates, Licensee data must be returned within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and Licensor must thereafter delete the data and certify deletion. The addition is targeted and leaves the original termination consequences intact. Drafting is professional, though “Licensee data” is not expressly defined and “thereafter” does not establish a specific deletion deadline.
